name: Penrose
description: Two rhombs, fat and thin, chosen by a rule on the cell index rather than by a dice roll.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 96% 50%, 50% 100%, 4% 50%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 96% 50%, 50% 100%, 4% 50%); @match(@i % 5 < 2) { -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 74% 50%, 50% 100%, 26% 50%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 74% 50%, 50% 100%, 26% 50%); } -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@i % 5 * 36)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(@i % 5 * 36)deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
